tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sde bdun gyi snying po rigs pa'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bsdus pa gnyis pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ sde bdun gyi snying po rigs pa'i de nyid rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs gser 'od 'phro bas rnam par mdzes/ /'chi med grong bzhud dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /kun gyis bsten 'os bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ba/ /skyob pa dbang po de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /nyin byed zer gyis mun pa'i tshogs la bzhin/ /dran pa tsam gyis gdung ba nyer sel zhing / /dri med yon tan 'phrin las tshad med pa'i/ /mkha' ltar bsam yas 'jam pa'i dpal la 'dud/ /gang zhig shar bas gzhan sde'i spu long dag /rnam par bcom zhing legs bshad pad mo'i tshal/ /rnam par rgyal mdzad mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong can/ /phyogs glang grags pa bcu gnyis bdag po rgyal/ /mdo dang sde bdun rin chen gling las legs 'ongs lugs bzang yid bzhin nor/ /len byed mkhas pa'i ded dpon gzhan med de slad bdag gis grags pa yi/ /bzhed don nor bu brtson pas blangs te 'di na mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed/ /rigs par smra ba su yang dus su gzhan dag dga' bar byed min nam/ /mi mkhas gzhan dag nyes bshad legs bshad du/ /rlom pas bstan bcos ngan la'ang 'bad pas na/ /rnam dag blo can mang thos brtson pa can/ /gzhung brgya smra ba kho bo cis mi brtson/ /'di na pad mo'i gnyen gyis phyogs rnams kun/ /gsal bar byed na bdag blo'i snang ba yis/ /shes bya ma lus ci phyir gsal mi byed/ /rigs pa'i de nyid 'dir ni rab gsal bya/ /'dir don dang don ma yin rnam par 'byed pa'i rgyu yang dag pa'i shes pa gtan la dbab par bya ba yin pa las/ don gsum gyis rtogs par bya ste/ tshul 'di thub pa'i dgongs par grub/ grub pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad/ rigs pa smra ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o/

/dang po ni gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar ma son zhing rang gi phyogs 'ba' zhig lhur len pa kha cig na re/ mngon sum rjes dpag la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag pa 'di dag 'bad pas lhur len par rigs pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ mdo dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las/ dam bca' ba dang / bshad pa dang / smras pa'i don sgrub pa dang / legs par khong du chud par bya ba'i rgyu gang yin pa dang / rkyen gang yin pa de ni 'thad pas sgrub pa'i rig pa yin no zhes dang / de ltar na 'thad pas sgrub pa'i rigs pa ni mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang / rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma dang / yid ches pa'i lung gi tshad mas mtshan nyid lnga po 'di dag gis yongs su dag pa yin no zhes dang / chos bcu par/ du ba las ni mer shes te/ /chu skyar las ni chu yin no/ /zhes dang / mdo sde gang cung zad skye ba'i chos can de thams cad ni 'gag pa'i chos can yin no/ /zhes dang / dge slong dag nga 'am nga 'dra bas gang zag gi tshod gzung gi gang zag gi tshod ma 'dzin cig ces pas bsgrub bya sgrub byed mngon sum rjes dpag rtags gsum rim pa ltar bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa grub pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa la/ /mtshan mtshon rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ des gtan la dbab bya'i don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ shes bya la chos gsum gyis khyab pa sgrub/ khyab byed chos gsum gyis rang bzhin bstan/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshon bya 'jog pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la dngos dang / rtsod spang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs shes bya ji snyed pa rnams la mtshan mtshon rten gsum gyis khyab ste/ rang rang gi rigs mi mthun las log cing rang ming gis brjod rung gang zhig mtshon gzhi'i rten du rung ba'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rigs mi mthun las log pa'i ngo bo ni mtshan nyid/ ming gi brjod rung ni mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang yul yin pa'i phyir yang mtshan nyid yod pas khyab ste/

lha dbang bloraṃ/ gzugs la sogs pa cung zad yul du gyur pa bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du mtshan nyid du rnam par bzhag pa de'i phyir zhes so/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa spang pa ni/ nog shal dang ba lang chos can/ shes bya ma yin par thal/ mtshan mtshon med pa'i phyir zhe na/ byas pa thams cad la mi rtag pas khyab bam ma khyab/ ma khyab na 'dus byas chos can/ mi rtag pa min par thal/ mi rtag pa las tha dad cing ma khyab pas so/ /khyab na mi rtag pa chos can/ byas pa min par thal/ mi rtag pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la chos gsum gyi rang bzhin/ nges pa'i rnam gzhag 'khrul pa spang ba gsum gyi dang po la/ so so'i mtshan nyid/ rang ldog ngos bzung / ji ltar 'brel tshul/ so sor mtshon tshul bzhi las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi dang / mtshan gzhi'am mtshon bya'i dang / mtshon bya'i gzhi rten gyi mtshan nyid do/ /dang po la/ dngos dang / gsal bya/ grangs nges gsum gyi dang po la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ rngog los/ mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan yin no zhe na/ rgyus bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid ma yin par thal/ mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan ma yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dang mtshon bya'i bar du byed pa'i gzhan gyis chod cing byas pa'i tha snyad byar rung bar ma chad par mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ chos mchog las/ des na bltos par bya ba gzhan des 'di dag bar du bcad pa de'i phyir/ de'i ltos par bya ba gang yin pa de nyid rnam par 'jog pa po yin gyi 'di dag ni ma yin pa des na tshad ma ma yin no zhes so/ /chu mig pa/ don ldog rkyang par grub pa mtshan nyid du 'dod na/ byas pa'i tha snyad bya rung chos can/ don ldog rkyang par grub pa srid par thal/ mtshan nyid srid pa'i phyir/ ral gri chos gang zhig rang nyid mtshon par byed pa zhes pa ltar na/ skad cig ma chos can/ mtshan nyid ma yin par thal/ rang mtshon byed ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na rang gi mtshan nyid du thal/

'dod na rang las tha dad du thal/ rang mtshon byar thal/ rang la khyab byed du thal lo/ /ci ste don ldog chos gsum tshang ba'o zhe na/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid chos can/ mtshan nyid du thal/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na mtshan nyid min par thal/ khyed kyi mtshan bya ma grub pa'i phyir te/ mtshon bya yin pas so/ /snga ma ma grub ste/ de'i mtshon bya mtshan nyid tha snyad yin pas so zhe na/ ma yin te/ don ldog chos gsum tshang pa las tha dad pa'i phyir/ skyon med de/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid don ldog chos gsum tshang ba min gyi/ chos gsum tshang ba de mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid do zhe na/ chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ khyod mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du nges par smos mi dgos par thal/ khyod ma smos kyang khyod kyi gsal bya de mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi zur don ldog ces pas sel zhing don ldog ma yin na mtshan nyid yin mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na mtshan nyid kyi zur phyi ma 'di ni rnam bcad gzhan med pas mtshan nyid gzhan du brjod bya min te/ rgyal dbang blor/ rnam par bcad par bya ba med pa'i phyir brjod par 'dod pa'i grangs gcig pa nyid kyang mtshan nyid gzhan nyid du brjod par bya ba ma yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs gzhag pa ni/ rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed du grub pa ste/ chos mchog las/ 'di ni bya ba dang ldan pa dang byed pa po'i dbang du gyur pa brjod pa yin no zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ gang las 'bras/ /gang yin de ni de sgrub byed/ /ces dang / chos mchog tu/ gang zhig byed pa po gzhan la ltos pa med par bya ba bye brag tu phyed pa'i byed pa po de ni byed pa yin no zhes dang / rgyal dbang bloraṃ/ mtshan nyid ces bya ba ni gang don gzhan las ldog pa'i ngo bo mtshon par bya ba rtogs par byed pa yin la zhes so/ /gsum pa rtsod spang la gsum las/

dang po mtshan nyid mi dgos pa spang ba ni/ kha cig mtshan nyid de mtshan nyid gzhan gyis mtshon mi dgos par thal/ rdzas yod min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan nyid thug med du 'gyur ro zhe na/ mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad byar rung de der thal zer na/ khyed rang gi 'dod pas ma grub cing / de'i don rang dbang du bar ma chad du mtshon pa dang / tha snyad kyi rten gzhi rgyu bskyed gnyis der thal ba ni 'dod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thug med du thal ba spang pa la gnyis las/ gzhan lan dgag pa ni/ mtshan nyid kyi don la thug pa yod kyang tha snyad thug med du 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya gnyis po de de'i tha snyad byar rung du mtshon pa la mtshan nyid gzhan dgos pas so zhes pa la/ gtsang nags pa/ bye brag tu mtshon pa'i tshe thug med yin te/ rgyus bskyed/ mtshan nyid du mtshon/ chos gsum tshang ba zhes dang / chos gsum dang po de rgyu bskyed mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la ltos te/ mtshan nyid du mtshon/ de la ltos te chos gsum gnyis pa tshang ba zhes dang / chos gsum gnyis pa de chos gsum dang po mtshan nyid dang po'i mtshon nyid du mtshon/ de la ltos te chos gsum gsum pa tshang ba zhes sogs blos spu ris zin zhing brjod pa ma 'khrul na thug med yin zer ro/ /de ltar na chos gsum gnyis pa de'i mtshon bya mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad dam/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad bya rung yin/ dang po ltar na mtshon bya gcig la mtshan nyid gnyis srid par thal/ chos gsum gnyis pa dang / dang po gnyis kyi mtshan nyid tha snyad mtshon pa'i phyir/ ma nges nas chos gsum dang po gnyis pa gnyis gcig go zhe na/ sbyor ba gnyis pa skyon med yin pa nyams so/ /gnyis pa ltar na rgyus bskyed mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad byar rung chos can/ rdzas yod ma yin par thal/ mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lan gdab pa ni/ dang po la gnyis pa dgod du mi rung ste/

mtshan nyid kyi rten gzhi dang mtshan nyid tha snyad med pas so/ /dang po la'ang mtshungs so zhe na/ don byed nus med chos can/ de bar ma chad par rang dbang du mtshon pa khegs par thal/ rgyus bskyed khegs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs so/ /des nas spyir mtshon pa na sbyor ba dang po'i tshe thug cing / bye brag tu mtshon pa na gnyis par thug pa yin te/ skad cig ma shes byar mtshon pa la blo'i yul rung bkod pa ni rtsa ba'i mtshon sbyor yin la/ blo'i yul rung mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed du grub pa mtshan nyid yin zhing / de'ang rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed du grub la mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad bya ste/ nog sogs 'dus pa la ba lang gi tha snyad sbyar ba bzhin zhes pas 'grub la/ bye brag sbyor gyi dpe ni 'di nyid do/ /gsum pa mtshan nyid min pa spang ba ni/ ba lang rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed du grub pa chos can/ mtshan nyid ma yin par thal/ mtshon byas khyad par du byas pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ lhas byin gyi zhang po zhes pa ltar/ ba lang gi mtshan nyid khyad par du shes pa'i don brjod kyang mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ yang na des mtshon nas ldog phyir/ /bsgrub bya'i dus su yang dag min/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bsal bya la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon thams cad bsdu na/ rang ldog rdzas su ma grub pa dang / don ldog gzhan 'gyur/ mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa gsum du 'dus par 'dod do/ /dang po ni/ mtshan nyid la ltos pa'i skyon/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon min gyi skyon yin la/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan gzhi ltos pa'i skyon du 'dod cing / rang ldog rdzas med kyi mtshan nyid kyang chu mig pas/ chos gang zhig don ldog rkyang par ma grub pa ste/ dbye na/ mtshon bya de nyid dang / gzhan dang de nyid kyis dang / gzhan gyis khyad par byas pa ste/

byas par mtshon pa la byas pa dang mi rtag pa dang / byas pa'i rgyus bskyed dang / mi rtag pa'i rgyus bskyed dgos pa bzhin no zhe na/ don ldog rkyang par ma grub pa chos can/ rang ldog rdzas su grub pa sel bar thal/ rang ldog rdzas ma grub kyi rigs mi mthun sel ba'i phyir ro/ /khyab pa khas blangs/ 'dod na rang ldog rdzas su grub pa mi sel bar thal/ rang ldog rdzas yod yin pa'i phyir te/ rang ldog mtshan nyid yin pas so/ /don ldog gzhan sbyor gyi mtshan nyid don ldog rkyang par grub cing / mtshon bya dgod bya de'i don ldog ma yin pa ste/ dbye na mi srid/ ma khyab/ khyab ches/ khyab mnyam pa'i don ldog gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste/ dang po la tha dad med nas dang / 'gal gnas mi srid pa skad cig ma dang / rtag pa la skad cig ma bkod pa lta bu dang / gnyis pa ni/ shes bya la skad cig ma dang / gsum pa ni/ bem po la skad cig ma dang / bzhi pa ni/ byas pa la skad cig ma bkod pa lta bu'o zhes so/ /de ltar na/ skad cig ma chos can/ rtag par mtshon pa la don ldog rkyang pa grub par thal/ rtag pa'i don ldog gzhan 'gyur yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rtag par mtshon pa la don ldog tu thal lo/ /skad cig ma chos can/ skad cig ma dang tha dad med nas mi srid pa min par thal/ rtag pa dang 'gal nas mi srid pa min par thal/ shes bya'i tha snyad la ma khyab pa min par thal/ skad cig ma dang tha dad med nas dang / rtag pa dang 'gal nas gzhi grub pa'i phyir dang / shes bya'i tha snyad la khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes bya'i bye brag min par thal lo/ /don ldog gzhan 'gyur mtshan nyid kyi skyon min pa'ang mi 'thad de/ don ldog gzhan gyur na mtshan nyid gzhan gyis bar chod pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa'i mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la ji ltar dgod bya ltar ma grub pa ste/ don ldog gzhan du dang / tha snyad gzhan du ma gyur nas dang / 'gal nas dang /

tha dad med nas mi srid pa bzhi ste/ byas pa byas par mtshon pa la rgyus bskyed dang / rgyus bskyed byas par mtshon pa la byas pa dang / dkar zal ba lang gi tha snyad dkar zal kho na la yod par mtshon pa la nog sogs dkar zal kho na la yod pa'am/ bum pa rtag par mtshon pa la 'jig med bkod pa dang / skad cig ma mi rtag par mtshon pa la skad cig ma bkod pa lta bu'o zhes 'dod do/ /de ltar na mtshon sbyor snga ma gnyis dang tha ma de chos can/ mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa min par thal/ mtshan gzhi la grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na rgyus bskyed chos can/ byas pa grub par thal/ byas pa la khyab pa'i phyir/ byas pa chos can/ rgyus bskyed la grub par thal/ rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma chos can/ skad cig ma la grub par thal/ byas pa'i phyir/ 'jig med chos can/ rtag pa'i mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa yin par thal/ rtag pa'i don ldog mtshan gzhi la ma grub pa min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na 'jig med rtag pa chos can/ khyod ni don ldog mtshan nyid ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi don ldog ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yang dag ma grub par thal/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi tha snyad bya rung mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /mi rtag pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid par thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la ji ltar dgod bya ltar ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na mtshan gzhi chos can/ dngos por thal/ skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs so/ /gzhan yang mtshan gzhi'i skyon rnams mtshan nyid kyi skyon du mi rigs te/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshon bya rkyang pa mtshon gyi mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya'i tshogs pa mi mtshon pa'i phyir/ des na sde bdun du'ang mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa mtshan nyid kyi skyon du ma gsungs shing / 'di mtshon sbyor gyi skyon yin pa ma go bar rtags kyi rgyab bkag nas mtshan gzhi la mtshan nyid grub dgos so zhes rtog cing /

mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya rgya skad cig la 'gyur gyis tha dad du song bas tha dad du 'khrul te don med pa'i spros pas ngal ba ni rang nyid blun por sgrub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhag pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed min par grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la ma khyab pa dang / khyab ches pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ kha cig mtshan nyid gang zhig mtshan gzhi'i phyogs gcig la ma grub pa'o zhes gsungs pa ni skyon med mod/ 'god tshul ltar na skad cig ma ma yin pa chos can/ 'god tshul ltar mtshan nyid ma khyab par thal/ 'god tshul ltar mtshan nyid gang zhig 'god tshul ltar mtshan gzhi'i phyogs gcig la ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na mtshan gzhi'i phyogs gcig chos can/ mi rtag par thal/ skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs so/ /gzhan dag mtshon ldan gyi phyogs gcig la ma khyab pa zhe na/ rgyus bskyed chos can/ byas pa'i mtshan nyid ma khyab par thal/ byas pa'i mtshan ldan gyi phyogs gcig la ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub pa min te/ byas pa'i mtshon ldan mi srid pa'i phyir te/ byas pa'i mtshon bya mi srid pas so/ /la la gzhi mtshon la srid kyang ma khyab pa zhe na/ snga ma nyid kyis khegs shing / lto ldir ba chos can/ mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ma khyab par thal/ mi rtag pa'i gzhi mtshon la srid kyang mi rtag pa la ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan nyid du thal lo/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ mtshan nyid gang zhig de rang dbang du mtshon byed min pa ste de'i don yang rang dbang du de la khyab byed du ma grub pa ste/ shākya bloraṃ/ khyab pa med pa ni khyab pa yod pa ma yin no zhes so/ /'di dang khyab ches kyi mtshan nyid kyi spyi sbyor ni skyon can kho na yin pas bye brag sbyor 'ba' zhig tu bya'o/ /mtshan nyid 'di ma khyab pa min te/ de rang dbang du mtshon byed yin na de la khyab pas nges par khyab pa'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa dbye ba ni gsum ste/ tha dad med nas dang / 'gal nas dang / mtshon gzhis khyad par du byas nas ma khyab pa ste/ skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid du skad cig ma dang / ba lang gi mtshan nyid du don byed nus med sogs tha snyad gzhan gyi mtshan nyid 'god par nog lkog shal khra bo mtshan nyid du bkod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyab ches la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig mtshan gzhi la khyab cing mtshon 'dod med par zhugs pa'o zhe na/ med dgag chos can/ ri bong gi rwa mtshon pa la khyab ches par thal/ ri bong gi rwa mtshon pa la mtshan nyid min pa'i phyir te/ mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma'i bsal pa zhal gyis bzhes so/ /kha cig mtshan nyid du bkod pa gang zhig rang gi mtshon byar bzung ba de med par yang zhugs pa zhe na/ rang gi mtshon byar bzung ba de med pa'i tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid chos can/ mtshan nyid khyab ches su thal/ mtshan nyid du bkod cing rang gi mtshon byar bzung ba de med par yang zhugs pa'i phyir te/ de la khyab pas so/ /'dod na mtshan nyid ma yin par thal lo/ /yang don byed nus med kyang der 'gyur ro/ /la la gzhi mtshon la khyab kyang gzhan la zhugs pa zhes smra ba la ni/ lto ldir ba dang rgyus bskyed chos can/ bum pa dang byas pa mtshon pa la khyab ches yin par thal/ bum pa dang byas pa mtshon pa'i gzhi mtshon la khyab kyang gzhan la zhugs pa'i phyir/ zur phyi ma ma grub na de gnyis gzhan min par thal lo/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ mtshan nyid gang zhig de mtshon byed min yang de la khyab pa ste/ shākya blor/ mngon par 'dod pa ma yin la 'jug pa med pa'i phyir shin tu khyab ches pa dang bral ba zhes rnam bcad kyi sgo nas don gyis de'i mtshon byar 'dod pa min pa'i tha snyad 'jug na khyab ches su gsungs so/ /de la spyir mtshan nyid ma yin na mtshan nyid khyab ches su mi rung la/ de kho na mtshon byed yin na khyab ches mi srid cing /

de la ma khyab na mtshan nyid ma khyab pa yin pas zur gsum po de nges par tshang ba gcig mtshan nyid khyab ches pa la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba ni gnyis te/ khyab mnyam pa'i dang / khyab mi mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid khyab ches pa ste/ byas par mtshon pa la skad cig ma dang / bem po mtshon pa la skad cig ma bkod pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ cha ba na re/ byas pa'i tha snyad byas pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la/ rgyus bskyed mtshan nyid du bkod pa de mtshan nyid kyi skyon mtshon 'dod med pa zhes bya ba yod par bshad pa de 'dir ma 'dus so zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni mtshan gzhi'i skyon min pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ mtshan gzhi'i skyon mtshan nyid kyi skyon min par sngar bstan pas so/ /kha cig rnam bcad med pa'i skyon byas pa'i mtshan nyid du rgyus bskyed kyi shes bya bkod pa lta bur de 'dir ma 'dus so zhe na/ ma yin te/ khyab ches yin pas so/ /'on kyang ba lang gi mtshan nyid du nog sogs 'dus pa zhes bkod pa lta bu rnam bcad med pa'i mtshan nyid yod mod kyang / de mtshan nyid kyi skyon du slob dpon mi bzhed kyi sbyor ba'i skyon yin par bzhed de/ rtsod rigs las/ gtan tshigs dang dpe lhag pa ni lhag pa'o zhes dang / gcig gi bya ba nyid kyi phyir cig shos don med pa yin no zhes dang / gang du sgrub par byed pa gcig gi ngag sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i rnam par dpyod pa de de la lhag pa brjod don med pa'i phyir tshar bcad pa'i gnas yin no zhes so/ /'o na gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / rgyal dbang blo las/ rnam dpyad med pa mtshan nyid kyi skyon gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni tshul gsum gyi bsal bya las gzhan pa'i bsal bya med pas grangs gcig par brjod par 'dod pa can tshul gsum las gzhan du rtags kyi mtshan nyid yin pa bkag gi rtags kyi mtshan nyid kyi skyon du gsungs pa min no/

/ci ste rtog pa phan tshun bsten pa zhes bya ba mtshan nyid kyi skyon gzhan yod pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni mtshan mtshon rtogs pa phan tshun brten pa ste/ dper na ba lang gi nog sogs 'dus pa bkod pa lta bu de'i mtshan nyid yin pa la de'i mtshon byas khyad par du byas pa yin te/ de'i mtshan nyid min na de'i mtshan nyid phan tshun brten par 'gal bas so/ /'di ni ma khyab pa yin te/ de'i mtshan nyid gnyis pa phan tshun brten pas gnyis ka nges par mi srid cing / ma nges na gcig la gcig gis khyab pa ma nges te/ gzhi ma nges pa'i khyab pa mi nges pas so/ /de ltar yang dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du gcig la gcig par 'gyur na zhes nyes she na/ gtan la phab pa med par 'gyur ro zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ phan tshun brten pas gcig 'dzin pa/ /med pas gnyis ka 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /ci ste nges mi nus pa zhes bya ba mtshan nyid kyi skyon gzhan yod pa min nam zhe na/ 'di ni mtshan nyid tshad mas nges mi nus pa yin te/ gtan tshigs thigs par/ nges par bya bar mi nus pa'i phyir 'di mtshan nyid ma yin no zhes te/ 'di la'ang snga ma bzhin ma khyab par 'du'o/ /ci ste rang ldog rdzas med 'dir ma 'dus so zhe na/ min te mtshan nyid mtshon bya de nyid dang gzhan gyis khyad par du byas pa ni ma khyab pa yin zhing mtshon bya yin na mtshan nyid min pas mtshan nyid kyi skyon du mi 'thad do/ /don ldog gzhan 'gyur la'ang mi srid pa ni ma khyab pa dang khyab mnyam ni khyab ches su 'dus la/ gzhi la mi srid pa'ang ci rigs par ma khyab dang khyab ches su 'dus par sngar bshad cing / mtshan gzhi kho na'i skyon ni mtshan nyid kyi skyon du mi rigs par bshad zin te/ rin chen grags/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon thams cad mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi srid par 'dus zer ba mi 'thad de/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi skyon yin par thal/

mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi srid pa'i phyir te/ mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir te/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa grangs nges ni mtshan nyid yin pa la tha snyad de la ma khyab na/ mtshan nyid ma khyab pa yin la/ khyab kyang de kho na la ma khyab na/ mtshan nyid khyab ches dang / de kho na la khyab na mtshan nyid yang dag yin pas rnam bcad la mtshan nyid kyi skyon gnyis su nges pas/ yongs gcod la de'i mtshan nyid yin na de la ma khyab khyab ches ma yin pa gcig dgos te/ slob dpon gyis/ rang nyid tshig phrad ngo bo'i sgra/ /ma bsal ba dang bcas pa dag /ldog pa sel bar byed pa yin/ /'dod sgras ma khyab sel bar byed/ /ces dang / shākya bloraṃ/ de tsam nyid don dam par phyogs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de tsam nyid kyis khyab pa med pa dang / khyab pa ches pa ldog pa'i phyir zhes so/ /skyon 'di dag mtshan nyid gzhir byas la brtsi dgos kyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshan gzhi'am mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid la/ mtshon bya ngos bzung / de'i mtshan nyid bshad/ bsal bya'i dbye ba dgag pa gsum gyi dang po la gsum gyi dang po la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ kha cig rigs sgra rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ba lang zhes sogs kyi ming de mtshon bya min la/ de btags yod yin te/ de blo yul du nges pa mtshan nyid nges pa la ltos pa'i phyir/ des na de don la ma grub pas blo'i chos sgro btags yin zhes gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dngos med chos can/ mtshon bya ma yin par thal/ ming ma yin pa'i phyir/ don byed nus med chos can/ rang gi mtshon bya dang bdag mi gcig par thal/ rang gi mtshon bya de ming yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na des 'jig med rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags de rang bzhin rtags ma yin par thal lo/ /byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshon bya srid par thal/ rgyu mtshan can gyi khyod kyi ming grub pa'i phyir/ yang dan 'bag na re/

sgra blos zhen rung mtshon bya yin zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rtag pa chos can/ rtag par 'dzin pa'i mtshon byar thal/ rtag par 'dzin pa'i sgra blo'i zhen rung tsam yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig don ldog gi rgyu mtshan gyi don blo dang sgra blo ma 'khrul ba tshogs pa'i zhen rung de yin te/ don blo ni myu gu'i steng du rgyus bskyed gzhan rigs mngon sum gyis grub pa de la brten nas mtshan nyid kyi don spyi shar ba gzhan sel phyin ci ma log pa 'dzin stangs don la ma 'khrul ba/ rgyu mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i tshad ma las skyes pa ste/ de 'dra'i rtog pa de la mtshan nyid kyi don spyi shar ba'i cha nas don blo dang / don ldog rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming spyi shar ba'i cha nas sgra blo zer zhing blo des zhen pa rgyus bskyed la zhen par byar rung ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du sbyar ba de mtshon bya byas pa yin no zhes zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ rgyus bskyed kyi rnam pa mi 'char ba'i rmongs pa chos can/ rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya mi srid par thal/ rgyus bskyed la de 'dra'i rtog pas zhen par byar rung ma grub pa'i phyir te/ rtog pa la rgyus bskyed kyi rnam pa mi 'char ba'i phyir/ 'dod na byas pa khegs par thal lo/ /deng sang phal cher rgyu mtshan can gyi tha snyad las 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dngos med chos can/ mtshon bya khegs par thal/ rgyu mtshan can gyi tha snyad khegs pa'i phyir dang / nog sogs 'dus pa chos can/ ba lang tha snyad mtshon par thal/ ba lang tha snyad kyi mtshon bya min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ba lang tha snyad chos can/ ba lang du thal/ nogs sogs 'dus pa'i mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ tha snyad ni sgra dang rnam rtog lus kyi bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ rgyu mtshan can gyi tha snyad kyi yul rgyu mtshan can gyi tha snyad kyis brjod rung yin te/ rnam 'grel du/ de phyir de yod pa las de'i/

/rgyu mtshan can gyi shes bya grub/ /ces dang / chos mchog tu/ gang la gang gi tha snyad kyi rgyu mtshan yod pa de la ni tha snyad du bya ba yin te zhes so/ /tha snyad byar rung 'di yang btags yod kho na yin te/ chos mchog tu/ tha snyad du rung ba nyid kyang btags pa yin gyi dngos po ni ma yin no zhes so/ /mtshon bya de nyid la mtshan gzhi zhes kyang zer te/ chos mchog tu/ mngon sum zhes bya bas ni mtshan gzhi rjes su brjod pa'o zhes dang / 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad du/ snam bu ni mtshan gzhi yin la zhes dang / mtshan gzhi ni mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas mtshon par bya ba'i dngos po'o zhes dang / a dza tās/ gtan tshigs zhes bya bas ni mtshan gzhi bstan to zhes so/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spang pa ni/ shes bya thams cad rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya yin par thal/ byas pa'i tha snyad byar rung yin pa'i phyir te/ yod pas so zhe na/ ma nges te/ byas pa'i tha snyad bya rung rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya yin gyi tha snyad bya rung yin pa la mtshon bya yin pas ma khyab ces byar rung mod kyi/ dngos lan ni rtags ma grub ste/ rgyus ma bskyed pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rgyu mtshan med par mi 'thad pa'i phyir te/ tha snyad 'jug par bya ba nyid la ni/ rgyu mtshan yod pa dang ldan pas khyab pa yin no zhes chos mchog las so/ /gnyis pa de'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ phya pa/ rang ldog gi rnam 'jog gi rgyu tshad mas nges par bya ba zhe na/ don byed pa chos can/ mtshon pa mi srid par thal/ rang ldog gi rnam 'jog gi rgyu tshad mas nges pa mi srid pa'i phyir te/ gtsang nags pa mtshan nyid kyis rnam par gzhag bya gzhi la grub ce na/ byas pa chos can/ mtshon bya ma yin par thal/ mtshan nyid kyi rnam par gzhag bya yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na mtshan nyid chos can/ dngos por thal/ byas pa'i rnam 'jog yin pa'i phyir/ chu mig pa chos gsum tshang ba ste/ rnam par gzhag bya yin/

mtshan nyid gzhan gyis gzhag bya min/ gzhi la grub pa'o zhe na/ mtshan nyid gzhan gyis rnam par gzhag bya chos can/ mtshon bya min par thal/ chos gsum ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ mtshan nyid gzhan gyis rnam par gzhag bya ma grub pa'i phyir/ ci ste btags yod rkyang par grub pa mtshan nyid do zhe na/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ btags yod rkyang par grub pas khyab par thal/ mtshon byas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rdzas yod rkyang par grub pa min par thal/ 'dod na mtshan nyid ma yin par thal lo/ /gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ bar ma chad par mtshon par byar rung du grub pa ste/ shākya blor/ gang las de chod pa med par 'grub par 'gyur ba de ltar sgrub par byed pa de nyid kyi yang bya ba de nyid yin te/ de nyid las rnam par gzhag pa thob pa yin no zhes so/ /'dis kyang snga ma ltar ma khyab khyab ches sel lo/ /gsum pa bsal bya'i dbye la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pa sogs rang ldog tha snyad du ma grub pa/ tha snyad gzhan gyur/ mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa gsum gyi/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ chos gang btags yod rkyang par ma grub pa ste/ dbye na mtshan nyid dang / des khyad par du byas pa bkod pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid de nyid dang / gzhan bkod pa dang / gnyis pa la de nyid dang / gzhan gyis khyad par du byas pa ste/ dper na bum pa rgyus bskyed dang / skad cig dang / rgyus bskyed kyis byas pa dang / skad cig gis byas par mtshon pa la rgyus bskyed bkod pa lta bu'o zhe na/ mtshan nyid yang dag chos can/ mtshon bya'i skyon du thal/ chos gang btags yod rkyang par ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshon bya skyon med la khegs pa thal lo/ /gnyis pa tha snyad gzhan gyur la yang mtshan nyid ni/ btags yod rkyang par grub kyang mtshan nyid du dgod bya de'i rnam par gzhag bya min pa ste/ dbye na/ mi srid/ ma khyab/ khyab ches/ khyab mnyam pa'i tha snyad gzhan gyur bzhi ste/ mi rtag par mtshon pa la mi rtag pa/

rig bya/ rig pa/ rgyus bskyed bkod pa bzhin no zhe na/ mtshan nyid du dgod bya chos can/ tha snyad gzhan gyur du thal/ mtshan nyid de tshang ba'i phyir te/ mtshon bya min mtshan nyid du dgod bya las tha mi dad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa tha snyad mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa la mtshan nyid ni/ mtshon bya mtshan gzhi la ji ltar dgod bya ltar ma grub pa ste/ dbye na tha snyad don ldog gzhan du ma gyur nas dang / 'gag nas dang / tha snyad med nas mi srid pa ste/ rgyus bskyed byas par mtshon pa la byas pa/ byas pa skad cig mar mtshon pa la skad cig bum pa rtag par mtshon pa la 'jig med/ byas pa byas par mtshon pa la rgyus bskyed bkod pa bzhin no zhe na/ mtshon bya yin pa chos can/ tha snyad mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa thal/ mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyir te/ mtshan gzhi btags yod chos gsum tshang ba min pa'i phyir/ dbye ba 'di dag kyang mi 'thad de/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'di dag phal cher la mtshan nyid kyi skyon yin te/ mtshon bya la ltos nas mtshan nyid kyi skyon rnams 'jog pas mtshan nyid skyon med du grub na mtshon bya'ang skyon med du grub cing / mtshan gzhi kho na'i skyon ni mtshan nyid kyi skyon min pas mtshon bya'i yang skyon min no/ /gsum pa mtshon bya'i rten gyi mtshan nyid la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bsal bya bzhi'i dang po ni/ rgyus bskyed la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / byas pa sogs mtshon bya thams cad mtshan gzhi'i rten du rung bas mtshan gzhi'i rten min pa mi srid do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ phya ba/ mtshan mtshon gyi chos zung gcig brten pa zhe na/ ba lang chos can/ mtshan gzhi min par thal/ mtshan mtshon gyi chos zung gcig mi brten pa'i phyir te/ mtshon bya mi brten pas so/ /kha cig mtshan nyid kyi rten byed pa'o zhe na/ byas pa byas pa'i mtshon gzhir thal lo/ /kha cig mtshon bya brten pa zhe na/

rgyus bskyed byas pa'i mtshan gzhir thal lo/ /kha cig mtshan mtshon skyon med zung gcig brten pa zhe na/ mtshan mtshon skyon can chos can/ mtshan gzhi min par thal lo/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ mtshon gzhir rung bar grub pa'o/ /gsum pa dbye ba la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ phya pas/ mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel pa nges pa'i gzhi ni/ mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i dang / byas pa lta bu tha snyad du mtshon pa'i gzhi gnyis po zhes pa'ang snga phyi gnyis ka'i gzhir rung ba dang / gang zhig gi 'brel pa nges pa'i gzhi de de'i mtshan gzhir mi rung ste/ de yin min du the tshom za ba med pa'i phyir/ dper na mthun dpe shes 'dod chos can du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /gangs she la sogs pa/ dngos po gnas thabs kyi dang / skyon yon brtse ba'i mtshon gzhi ste/ ba lang mtshon pa la dkar zal dang / mtshan gzhir bkod pa tsam bzhin no zhes dang / mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba gnyis te/ ba lang la ltos te dkar zal dang / rta lta bu'o zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ phyi ma gnyis la mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dgag pa ni/ dngos po dngos med gnyis ka la brten pa'i gzhi bum pa/ 'jig med/ shes bya lta bu gsum mo/ /gnyis pa bsal bya la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya mi brtan pa gnyis te/ de nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyang mtshan gzhir bkod kyang ji ltar mtshon pa ltar don ldog gi rten mi byed pa dang / mtshan gzhir bkod kyang mtshon chos kyi rten ji ltar mtshon pa ltar mi byed pa zhe na/ rim pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang mtshon byas ma nges la/ dbye ba yang / chu mig pas/ mtshan nyid mi brten pa la/ mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa ltar bzhi yod la/ mtshon bya mi brten pa la'ang tha snyad mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa ltar/ gzhi yod ces pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mtshan nyid mi brten na mtshon bya'ang mi brten la/ de brten na de'ang brten zhing / mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid la'ang de dang 'dra bas so/

/gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ spyi rigs nas/ mtshan gzhir mi rung ba mi srid kyang / bye brag la srid pas de'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa'i gzhir mi rung bar grub bo/ /dbye na tha dad med nas dang / 'gal nas dang / the tshom za nas dang / tshad mas ma grub nas mtshan gzhir mi rung ba'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid tha dad med nas dang / mtshon bya dang tha dad med nas gzhir mi rung ba gnyis te/ byas par mtshon pa la rgyus bskyed dang / byas pa mtshon gzhir bkod pa bzhin no/ /'gal ba dang the tshom za ba ni byas par mtshon pa la 'jig med dang / sha za'i bum pa gzhir bkod pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni sha pa tshad mas ma grub pa'i gang zag la sha pa dngos po'i gzhir bkod pa lta bu'o/ /'di dag ni sbyor ba'i skyon yin pas mtshon gzhir bkod pa la brtsi'o/ /gnyis pa rang ldog ngos gzung ba la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig chos gsum gyi rang ldog sgrub pa kho na yin no/ /rang gi rnam pa rang dbang du 'char ba'i sgo nas nges pa'i phyir zhe na/ min te/ gzhan sel pa yin pas de min bcad pa la ltos so/ /kha cig chos gsum gyi rang ldog dang don ldog sgrub pa'o zhes pa mi 'thad de/ sgrub chos tsam dor chos can/ sgrub par thal la/ de ldog chos pa rnams 'dod mod/ de lta na dgag pa chos can/ khyed bkag pa sgrub pa ma yin par thal/ sgrub chos tsam dor/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ sgrub chos tsam dor/ bkag pa sgrub pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /zur phyi ma ma grub na/ shes bya la chos can/ dngos 'gal gyi dgag pa yin na cig shos sgrub pas ma khyab par thal/ sgrub chos tsam dor yin ma yin dngos 'gal gnyis ka sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ chos gsum gyis ma yin dgag sgrub na sgrub pa med dgag sgrub na dgag pa yin no/ /gsum pa ji ltar 'brel tshul la gnyis kyi dang po dngos ni/ ngo bo gcig tu 'brel zhing gzhi ldog gcig la brten par 'gal lo/

/gnyis pa nges byed la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ dpe ni myu gu'i steng du mtshan nyid rgyus bskyed gzhan rig mngon sum gyis grub la/ de'i rjes kyi rtog pas rgyus bskyed la zhen rung gi cha mtshon bya de bzhin byed kyi rtog pa myong ba'i rang rig gi shugs la 'grub ste/ zhen byed kyi rtog pa de dngos su grub pas so zhe na/ mtshon byachos can/ rang rig gi yul yin par thal/ rang rig gis grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de ma yin par thal/ dngos por med pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ chos mchog las/ mngon sum gyis shes par bya ba ma yin te/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gzhan yang rgyus bskyed byas pa chos can/ gzhan rig mngon sum la snang mi snang cha gnyis mi 'thad par thal/ phyi rol gyi don khyab mnyam rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rgyus bskyed chos can/ bum pa byas par sgrub pa la/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags su thal/ byas pa dang 'brel pa don la yod pa dngos stobs kyi tshad mas grub cing / tshul gsum par nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ mkhas pas mtshan nyid mthong ba na sngar gyi brda dran pas 'grub la/ rmongs pa la sngar 'brel pa grub pa'i dpe la 'brel ba bstan pa las dang / shin tu blun po la mtshan mtshon gyi brda 'brel sbyar ba las 'grub ste/ chos mchog tu/ mngon sum du snang ba'i yul gyi dngos po la yang rmongs pa la ni mtshan nyid pa'i rjes su dpag pa las tha snyad du 'gyur la/ rmongs pa ma yin pa la ni mngon sum nyid las so zhes dang / tha snyad kyi yul can mtshan nyid kyi gtan tshigs de ni lan cig tha snyad zhugs pa nyid las tha snyad dang 'brel par shes par 'gyur te/ dper na ba lang gi tha snyad kyi rgyu mtshan lkog shal la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yul la lan gcig tha snyad zhugs pa las kyang 'brel pa shes par 'gyur ba lta bu ste zhes dang / mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid grub pa la ni mtshan nyid rjes su brjod nas mtshan nyid shes par byed la/

mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid kyi dngos po ma grub pa'i ngag las ni mtshan nyid sgrub par byed do/ /dper kun tu rgyu'i rtags ni gtsug phud yin no zhes bya ba'i ngag las kun tu rgyu rjes su brjod pa dang / gtsug phud bsgrub pa de bzhin zhes so/ /bzhi pa so sor mtshon tshul la/ rang ldog la brten par dang / gzhan ldog ma yin par mtshon tshul dang / 'ga' mtshungs kyi sbyor ba bshad pa gsum gyi dang po la dngos dang / rtsod spang gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis kyi/ spyir mtshon tshul ni/ bum pa chos can zhes pa rigs kyang da lta ba dang sgo bstun pa na bum pa mtshan gzhi byas pa'i tha snyad byar rung rgyu rkyen las skyes pa zhes pa rtsa sbyor te/ de gsum rim pa dang mtshan gzhi/ mtshon bya/ mtshan nyid dang / gzhi ldog rang ldog dang / rten/ bya ba/ byed pa po nyid do/ /de la spyir mtshon gsum ni rgyus bskyed mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la bar ma chod par dbang du mtshon byed grub pa dang / byas pa mtshon byar mtshon pa la bar chad par mtshon par byar rung du grub pa dang / bum pa mtshan gzhi'i rten du mtshon pa'i gzhir rung bar grub pa'o/ /de la bod rnams mtshan nyid tha snyad la mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid yin min gnyis kas khyab ste/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid mtshon bya yin zhing / de'i phyir mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung gi bye brag yin pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin du mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid la/ mtshon bya yin min gnyis kas khyab ste/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin zhing / mtshon bya ma yin pa'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir zhes so zer ro/ /mtshan gzhi'i tha snyad la ni mtshon gzhis khyab ste gzhi'i bye brag yin pas so/ /'on kyang gzhi min pas ma khyab ste/ gzhi min mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bye brag tu mtshon tshul ni/ rgyus bskyed byas pa'i mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la byas pa bar ma chod par rang dbang du mtshon byed du grub pa dang /

byas pa rgyu bskyed kyi mtshon byar mtshon pa la rgyu bskyed kyi bar ma chod par mtshon par byar rung du grub pa dang / bum pa byas pa'i mtshon pa'i mtshon pa la byas pa mtshon pa'i gzhir rung bar grub pa'o/ /'dir yang mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid la gzhi yin min gnyis kas khyab ste gzhi'i bye brag yin la byas pa'i gzhir tshad mtshon pa'i mtshan gzhi min pas so zhe na/ /bod dag zer ro/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis te spyir dang / bye brag tu mtshon tshul rtsod pa spangs pa'o/ /dang po la zhugs ma zhugs kyi rtsod lan dang / khegs ma khegs kyi rtsod lan gnyis kyi dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid tha snyad la dang / rtsa ba'i gzhi mtshon la zhugs ma zhugs kyi rtsod lan no/ /dang po la gnyis kyi rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ mtshan nyid tha snyad la mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid zhugs na mtshan nyid tha snyad de mtshan nyid yin na/ de'i mtshan nyid mi srid par thal/ min na mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid khyab ches su thal/ mtshan nyid min pa la zhugs pa'i phyir/ ci ste ma zhugs na mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid de rang gi mtshon bya la mi srid par thal/ mtshan nyid tha snyad la ma zhugs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan bstan pa la gsum las dgag pa ni/ gtsang nag pas/ mtshan nyid tha snyad mtshan nyid min pas rang ldog la mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid mi brten pas/ khyab ches pa min la/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid mtshon ldan gyi gzhi la zhugs pas mi srid pa'i skyon med do zhe na/ mtshon bya min pa mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad bya rung du mtshon pa la btags yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshan nyid du bkod pa de chos can/ mtshon bya yin pa'i tha snyad la srid pa thal/ mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad ldan pa'i gzhi la zhugs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na gzhi mtshon tha dad med nas mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa min par thal lo/ /bsal pa khas blangs so/ /yang mtshon bya min pa la mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad byar rung du sgrub pa la 'gal ba'i rtags su mi 'gyur par yang thal lo/

/snga ma rtags ma grub na der thal/ mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad 'god tshul ltar yod pa'i gzhi la zhugs pas so/ /chu mig pas/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid de mtshon bya rten gyi rigs mthun mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi rang ldog la brten par ma zhugs shing mtshan nyid tha snyad dumatshon pa'i mtshan nyid la zhugs pas skyon gnyis ka med do zhe na/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi rang ldog chos can/ don ldog chos gsum brten par thal/ mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshon gzhir rung ba'i phyir te/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung yin khyod ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid du ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub ste/ mtshan nyid tha snyad dang tha dad med pas so zhe na/ rgyus bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid tha snyad bya rung gi rang ldog tu thal/ mtshan nyid tha snyad bya rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na don ldog chos gsum tshang ba'i mtshon bya thal te/ snga phyi'i khyab pa khas blangs so/ /de mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung min te/ mtshan nyin min pas so zhe na/ bum pa'i ldog pa'ang bum pa min par mtshungs so/ /de ltar 'dod pa mi rigs te/ de la bum pa'i spyi yin pa'i phyir te/ shākya blor/ spyi'i blo rnam par rtog pa can la de ltar rnam pa gcig tu snang ba'i phyir ldog pa la spyi zhes bya'o zhes so/ /gzhan yang mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi ldog chos can/ khyod brjod pa'i sgra de mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi chos brjod kyi sgra min par thal/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung min pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid tha snyad du mtshon pa'i gzhi la chos gsum tshang ba zhugs pa'ang mi 'thad de/ tha snyad sgra rtog yin pas mtshan nyid min pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung gi yul can gyi sgra rtog chos can/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung la gzhan sel las 'jug pa'i sgra rtog don mthun ma yin par thal/ de min bsal nas mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung la mi 'jug ba'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rnam 'grel du/ de yis de dag rnams las 'di/

/mi gcod na ni de ji ltar/ /zhes so/ /rtags grub ste/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung ste/ mtshan nyid tha snyad bya rung chos can/ der thal/ gzhi grub de las tha dad min pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ de nyid du/ de las tha dad min de nyid/ /ces so/ /kha cig chos gsum tshang ba de mtshan nyid tha snyad la zhugs pas mi srid pa min la/ rang gi mtshon bya la zhugs pas khyab ches pa min no zhe na/ 'god tshul ltar zhugs na mtshan nyid du thal la/ ma zhugs na lan du ma 'brel lo/ /gzhan yang rang ldog la brten par ma zhugs pas ma zhugs par 'gyur na me du ba la ma zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /des na mtshan nyid tha snyad la zhugs ma zhugs 'dri ba'i skabs su rang ldog dang de mtshon gyi mtshan nyid gnyis su btags nas lan 'degs pa ni ltag chod yin no/ /gnyis pa rang len gdab pa ni/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid des rang gi mtshon gzhi ma lus pa la khyab pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung la zhugs shing / khyab ste/ shākya blor/ mtshan gzhi ma lus la khyab pa'i phyir yod pa can dang zhes so/ /des na mi srid pa'i skyon med pa la bsal bya'i rigs mi mthun mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung gi mtshon gzhi ma lus pa la 'god tshul ltar 'jug pa khegs pas mi mthun phyogs la khyab ches pa'ang med do/ /des na mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung ni mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung min te/ bar ma chod par rang dbang du mtshon byed du grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa rtsod spangs ni/ ma grub ste/ mtshon bya yin pas so zhe na/ de chos can/ dngos 'gal gzhi mthun srid par thal/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung yang yin/ /de dang dngos 'gal yang yin/ gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dngos 'gal la/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig spangs pa mi dgos par thal lo/ /'di skad zer ba ni/ bod snga ma dag gis kyang dgongs pa ma lon pa yin te/ snga ma dag rung ba mtshon byar mi byed kyi tha snyad mtshon byar bzhed pas mtshan nyid tha snyad de mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung du gsungs pa yin no/

/'o na mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung de mtshon bya ma yin par thal/ mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan nyid mtshan nyid kyi yang mtshon bya ma yin par thal ba'i phyir zhe na/ rtog pa chos can/ rang gi ngo bo la mngon sum min par thal/ mngon sum min pa'i phyir/ des na bum pa lta bu'i gzhi gcig gi steng du de'i mtshan nyid yin na de'i mtshon byar 'gal/ mtshan nyid yin yang mtshon byar mi 'gal te/ mtshan mtshon gnyis po de gzhi gcig la tha dad du rtog pas phye ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra'i brjod bya bzhin no/ /gsum pa nyes spong dgag pa ni/ mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi rigs mi mthun min par thal/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyis bsal bya min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan nyid mtshan nyid la ltos te mtshon bya de rten gyi rigs mi mthun par thal zhe na ma nges te/ mtshan mtshon gyi skabs su mtshon bya rten gyi rigs mi mthun de mtshan nyid de'i rigs mi mthun min pas so/ /yin na khyed kyi lugs la mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung chos can/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba las ldog par thal/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba'i rigs mi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ rnam 'grel du/ gang phyir dngos kun rang bzhin gyi/ /rang rang ngo bo la gnas phyir/ /mthun dngos gzhan gyi dngos dag las/ /ldog pa la ni brten pa can/ /zhes so/ /'on te ma nges te de'i rigs mi mthun yin yang bsal bya'i rigs mi mthun min pas de las mi ldog ce na/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ don ldog chos gsum tshang ba min pa las mi ldog par thal/ de khyod kyi bsal bya'i rigs mi mthun min pa'i phyir te/ de mtshan nyid min pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas mtshan nyid tha snyad byar rung yin pas so/ /'dod na de mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung las kyang mi ldog don ldog chos gsum tshang ba min pa las kyang mi ldog pas ldog gzhi cir 'gyur ba soms shig

'dis ni mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad byar rung la zhugs na/ khyab ches shing ma zhugs na mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad mtshon bya min par 'gal zhes pa'i lan bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa rtsa ba'i gzhi mtshon la zhugs ma zhugs kyi rtsod lan la gnyis las rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid de/ gzhi rgyus bskyed lta bu'i gzhi mtshon bum byas la zhugs na khyab ches su thal/ mtshon bya med pa'i gzhi la zhugs pa'i phyir/ ma zhugs na gzhi bum pa de byas par mtshon byed min par thal lo zhe na/ gnyis pa lan bstan pa la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ kha cig de bum pa byas pa ma zhugs shing rgyus bskyed de gzhi bum pa la zhugs shing byas pa'i don ldog yin pas skyon gnyis ka med do zhes pa mi 'thad de/ bum byas chos can/ chos gsum tshang bar zhugs par thal/ rgyus bskyed zhugs pa'i phyir/ ci ste de lta na mtshan nyid tha snyad bya rung du thal lo zhe na ma nges te/ chos gsum tshang ba ma yin pas so/ /'on te chos gsum tshang ba 'god tshul ltar ma zhugs pas thal ba snga ma ma nges so zhe na/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba chos can/ mtshon bya yin pa ma zhugs par thal/ mtshon bya yin pa 'god tshul ltar ma zhugs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshon bya yin pa'i khyab bya min par thal/ 'dod na mtshon bya yin min gnyis kas khyab pa 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa rang lan gdab pa ni/ bum byas la zhugs kyang mtshan nyid tha snyad med pa'i gzhi la zhugs par mi 'gyur te/ bum byas la mtshan nyid tha snyad rbang ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'god tshul ltar ma zhugs pas/ khyab ches min zhing / rgyus bskyed la 'god tshul ltar zhugs pas mtshon byed min pa'i skyon yang med de/ de nyid kyis byas pa'i mtshan nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bum pa byas par mtshon byed min te/ bum pa byas pa tha dad nas byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas so/ /'dis ni mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bum pa dang rgyus bskyed la zhugs ma zhugs kyi lan yang don gyis btab pa yin no/

/gnyis pa khyab ma khyab kyi rtsod lan la gnyis las/ rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ rgyus skyed chos can/ mtshan nyid tha snyad brten pa khegs par thal/ mtshon bya mi brten pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ spyi bkag pas bye brag mi khegs par thal lo zhe na/ gnyis pa lan bstan pa gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ chu mig pa thal ba dang po ma nges shing gnyis pa 'dod de/ stong nyid la mtshon bya mi brten yang dgag pa'i tha snyad brten pas so zhes pa mi 'thad de/ stong nyid chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid ma grub par thal/ mtshon bya min pa'i phyir/ yang spyi chos can/ bye brag dang khyab mnyam min par thal/ de bkag pas bye brag mi khegs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lan gdab pa ni/ rtags ma grub ste/ byas pa'i tha snyad brten pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu mtshon tshul la rtsod pa spang ba la gsum ste/ khegs ma khegs kyi dang / gzhi mtshan tha dad med pa'i dang / de nyid du thal ba'i rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las rtsod pa ni/ byas pa'i mtshan nyid du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid de rgyus bskyed kyi gzhi mtshon bum byas la khegs na de'i phyir/ bum byas chos can/ rgyus bskyed kyang khegs par thal la/ ma khyab na/ mtshon gzhi la mtshan nyid kyis ma khyab par thal/ mtshan nyid khegs kyang gzhi ma khegs pa'i phyir/ ma khegs na khyab ches su 'gyur te/ rang gi mtshon bya'i rigs mi mthun byas pa'i mtshan nyid tha snyad byar mi rung la ma khegs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig thal ba snga ma ma nges zhes pa mi 'thad de/ byas pa chos can/ byas pa'i mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid mi khegs par thal/ rgyus bskyed dang khyab mnyam pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ rtsa ba'i thal rtags ma grub cing / de lta na'ang / khyab ches pa min te/ mtshon bya'i rigs mi mthun la 'god tshul ltar ma zhugs pa'i phyir/ mtshon sbyor skor gcig po de'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshan gzhi la ma khyab pa'ang 'dod de/

shes bya ba lang min pa'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshon gzhi yin yang ba lang min pa khegs kyang mi khegs pas ba lang min pas khyab pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las rtsod pa ni/ rgyus bskyed pa'i don ldog chos gsum tshang ba yin na/ rgyus bskyed byas pa'i mtshan nyid du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid chos gsum tshang ba de gzhi mtshon tha dad med par thal la/ min na byas pa'i mtshan nyid min par thal lo zhe na/ gnyis pa lan la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig rgyus bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ldog pa min zhing rten gzhi yin pas skyon gnyis po med ces pa ni mi 'thad do/ /rgyus bskyed chos can/ byas pa'i don ldog chos gsum tshang ba'i ldog par thal/ khyod las tha dad pa'i byas pa'i don ldog mi srid/ khyod byas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma ma grub na/ byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid gnyis srid par thal/ rgyus bskyed de'ang / khyod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ rgyus bskyed las tha dad pa'i khyod kyi mtshan nyid grub pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi rtags zur phyi ma khas blangs so/ /kha cig rgyus bskyed byas pa'i rnam 'jog chos gsum pa'i rten gzhi min par thal/ khyod las tha dad pa'i byas pa'i don ldog chos gsum tshang ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ zhes rten gzhi yin pa la skyon brjod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ de las tha dad pa'i de mi srid kyang byas pa'i don ldog chos gsum pa de/ de las tha dad cing de de yin pas gzhir rung ngo / /gnyis pa rang lan gdab pa ni/ rgyus bskyed byas pa'i don ldog chos gsum tshang ba yin pas byas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i skyon med la/ ldog pa tha dad pas gzhi mtshon tha dad med pa'i skyon yang med do/ /'dis ni byas pa la rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid grub na gzhi mtshon tha dad med par thal la/ ma grub na rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya min par thal ba'i skyon yang don gyis spangs pa yin no/

/gsum pa de nyid du thal ba spang ba ni/ rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon bya'i tha snyad dang byas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad chos can/ der thal/ de las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ rgyus bskyed byas pa'i mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhan ldog ma yin par mtshon tshul gnyis kyi dngos la/ spyi sbyor ni byas pa mtshan nyid min pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed min par grub pa dang / rgyus bskyed mtshon bya min par mtshon pa la bar ma chad par mtshon par byar rung min par grub pa ste/ mtshan gzhi min par mtshon pa'i spyi sbyor ni skyon can kha na'o/ /bye brag sbyor ni bum pa byas pa'i mtshan nyid min par mtshon/ byas pa rang dbang du bar ma chod par mtshon byed min par grub pa'o/ /rgyus bskyed rgyus bskyed kyi mtshon pa min par mtshon/ rgyus bskyed kyi bar ma chad par mtshon par byar rung min par grub pa dang / byas pa byas pa'i mtshon gzhi min par mtshon/ byas pa mtshon pa'i gzhir rung ba min par grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa spang pa la gnyis te/ mtshon bya yin min/ mtshan gzhi la zhugs ma zhugs brtags nas mi 'thad pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ rtsod pa ni/ mtshon bya min pa de mtshon bya yin na mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag nas mtshon par 'gal la/ min na mtshan nyid la mi ltos par 'gyur ro zhe na/ gnyis pa lan la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ de mtshon bya'i rang ldog min pas mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag nas mtshon pa mi 'gal/ rten gzhi yin pas rnam 'jog la ltos zhes gsung ngo / /de lta na byas pa'i tha snyad chos can/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag nas mtshon pa mi 'gal bar thal/ mtshon bya'i rang ldog min pa'i phyir/ chu mig pas/ de'i rten gzhi de mtshon bya min zhing rang ldog mtshon pa yin pas skyon med ces pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mtshan nyid tha snyad chos can/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag nas mtshon pa mi 'gal bar thal/

de'i rten gzhi de mtshon bya min zhing rang ldog mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir dang / mtshon bya min pa de mtshon byar brda sbyar ba med na mi 'byung bar thal lo/ /'dis ni don ldog chos gsum ma tshang ba'i rang ldog mtshan nyid yin pa'ang bkag go /gnyis pa rang lan gdab pa ni/ mtshon bya ma yin pa mtshon bya min pas skyon dang po med la/ mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad byar rung mtshon bya yin pas de bar chad par mtshon par byar rung min pa'i chos kyis mtshon pa mi 'gal lo/ /des na mtshon cha'i mtshan nyid bkag pas mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad mi mtshon gyi/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag pa de yin par grub pas de mtshon te/ mtshon bya min par ri bong rwa la grub kyang mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad byar rung ma grub pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid la zhugs ma zhugs brtags na mi 'thad pa spang ba la gnyis las/ rtsod pa ni/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid de mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad la zhugs na khyab ches la/ ma zhugs na mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad gzhir mi rung bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis las dgag pa ni/ kha cig rang ldog la zhugs shing rten gzhi la ma zhugs pas skyon med ces pa mi 'thad de/ rang ldog la zhugs pa nyid kyi rten gzhi la rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lan ni/ de la zhugs kyang mtshon bya yin pa la zhugs pas skyon gnyis med do/ /gsum pa 'gal mtshungs kyi sbyor ba bshad pa la gnyis te/ sbyor ba'i dbye ba dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la 'gal bar 'dra la mi 'gal ba'i dang / mtshungs par 'dra la mi 'gal ba'i dang / mtshungs par 'dra la mi mtshungs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ gzhi mtshan 'gal bar 'dra la mi 'gal ba ni/ mig gis gzung bya rtags yang dag min te/ tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa na tshul gsum ma tshang ba mtshon gzhi/ rtags yang dag gi tha snyad rung tshul gsum tshang ba zhes pa ste/

gzhi de mig gi gzung bya rtags yang dag ma yin par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pas gzhi mtshon mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa gzhi mtshon 'gal bar 'dra la mi 'gal ba ni/ mtshon bya ma yin pa'i tha snyad mtshon byar mtshon pa la bar ma chad par mtshon par byar rung du grub pa zhes bkod pa ste/ gzhi de mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkag pa'i mtshon bya yin pas mtshon bya'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir gzhi mtshon mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ gzhi mtshan mtshungs par 'dra la mi mtshungs pa ni/ rgyus bskyed kyi ldog pa nyid byas pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la rgyus bskyed pa'o/ /de'ang gzhi mtshan tha dad de/ rgyus bskyed kyi chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra'i brjod bya yin pas brdas phye ba'i tha dad pa tsam yod do/ /gnyis pa gzhi mtshon mtshungs par 'dra la mi mtshungs pa ni/ shes bya'i ldog pa shes bya'i tha snyad byar rung blos rig bya ste/ gzhi mtshon gnyis chos dang chos can yin pas tha dad med de 'dra yang yod do/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ mtshon bya ma yin pa'i tha snyad chos can/ mtshon bya'i bye brag min par thal/ mtshon bya'i rigs mi mthun pa las mi ldog pa'i phyir/ ma grub na mtshon bya min pa la rjes su mi 'gro bar thal lo/ /ci te mtshon brten pas mtshon bya'i bye brag yin na/ ri bong rwa med chos can/ dgag pa'i bye brag tu thal/ 'dod na dgag pa khegs na khegs par thal/ de'ang 'dod na dgag pa bkag pa chos can/ ri bong rwa med khegs par thal/ dgag pa khegs pa'i phyir dang / shes bya la chos can/ gzhi gcig la chos dngos 'gal gnyis sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis srid par thal/ byas pa mtshon bya'i tha snyad du sgrub pa la mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkod na yang rtags yang dag yin/ byas pa de mtshon bya min pa'i tha snyad du sgrub pa la mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid bkod na yang phyogs khyab tshang ba'i phyir zhe na/ thal ba snga ma bum pa las tha dad min pas ma nges so/

/thal ba gnyis pa'i bar pa'ang ma nges te/ mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid kyang 'god tshul ltar mtshan nyid khegs na khegs par thal bas so/ /thal ba gsum pa'i rtags zur phyi ma ma nges te/ rang mtshan gyi mtshan nyid chos can/ gser bum rang mtshan yin min du sgrub pa'i rtags dag yin par thal/ gser bum rang mtshan du bsgrub pa la rtags yang dag yin zhing rang mtshan min pas khyab pa'i phyir/ sgro btags yin pa'i phyir te/ gnyis pa phan tshun nges pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de/ rnam 'grel du/ gal te bya byed gcig yin par/ /'gal lo zhe na mi bden te/ /chos tha dad par khas len phyir/ /dngos su tha dad med par 'dod/ /bya ba byed pa'i tha snyad dag /thams cad de ltar rnam par gnas/ /zhes so/ /khyab mnyam pa'ang yin te/ mtshan nyid la ma khyab khyab ches dang bral ba dgos par gsungs pas so/ /mtshan nyid don gyi cha dang mtshon bya btags cha yin la/ rnam 'grel las zhes so/ /yang 'di dag don dam par grub pa ma yin te/ de nyid du/ dper na thag ring mya ngam na/ /chung ngu chen po snang ba bzhin/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag /yod pa min yang gzhal bya dang / /'jal byed 'bras bur gnas pa 'di/ /ji ltar rjes su snang bzhin byas/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa de la 'khrul pa la spang ba ni/ snga rabs pa dag mtshan mtshon grangs mnyam yin pas mtshon bya gcig la mtshan nyid du ma dang / mtshan nyid gcig la mtshon bya gnyis mi srid ces 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyis rang spyi gnyis la mtshan nyid bzhi bzhi dang / tshad ma la mtshan nyid gnyis dang / don byed pa la mtshon bya dngos po dang / rang mtshan gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /ci ste grangs mi mnyam na rnam 'grel du/ /bya ba la ni chod pa'i phyir/ /tshad ma nyid du mi 'dod de/ /zhes ji ltar grang zhe na/ de'i don dbang sogs de don rtogs kyi tshad ma min pas don rtogs mtshon pa la byed pa gzhan don 'dra bas chod pas tshad ma min par gsungs la/

snga ma ni gnyis ka tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin pas bar ma chod pa'i phyir mtshan nyid yin no/ /des na bar chod pa'i don go yang de'i mtshan nyid yin pas de mtshon nus pa yin gyi/ de las tha dad pa'i de'i mtshan nyid 'gog pa min no/ /gsum pa mtshan nyid kyi mtshon bya 'jog pa'i tshul la gnyis las dang po ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad rnam 'jog gi rgyu dang mtshon bya thams cad rnam gzhag gi 'bras bu yin pas mtshan nyid kyi mtshon gzhi la mtshon rdzas sam dngos po la brten pa'i chos rnams rdzas la brten pa'i chos dang / mtshon bya dngos por med pa la brten pa'i chos rnams dngos por med pa dang gnyis ka la brten pa'i chos rnam gnyis ka la brten pa'i chos su 'jog ste/ rnam 'grel du/ dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka la/ /brten phyir spyi de'ang rnam pa gsum/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rdzas ldog dang rdzas ldog la brten pa'i chos kyi rnam gzhag snga rabs pa 'dod pa ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin pas re zhig bzhag go /mtshan mtshon mtshan nyid de yi dbye ba dang / /bsal bya'i rnam gzhag sngon chad byas mod kyi/ /sde bdun mdo dang 'gal bar mthong nas ni/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug lugs bzhin gsal bar bkod/ /rigs pa'i de nyid rab tu gsal ba las mtshan mtshon rnam par 'byed pa'i yongs su bcad pa ste dang po'o/ /gnyis pa des gtan la dbab bya'i don bshad pa la gnyis te/ yul yul can gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ khyad par tshad mas gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la rtogs byed blo/ rtogs bya yul/ rtogs pa'i tshul gsum gyi dang po la gnyis kyi mtshan nyid la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ kha cig rig par gnas pa zhe na/ de chos can/ blo'i mtshan nyid min par thal/ blo dang rnam grangs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos mchog las/ shes pa dang blo dang rtog pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs pa yin la zhes so/ /khyab pa yod/ blo dang de grub ma grub kyi khyad par mi 'thad pas/

rtags dang rtags can du mi rung ba'i phyir te/ de nyid du/ sgra tha dad pas don tha dad pa'am grub pa dang ma grub par 'gyur ba ni mi 'thad do zhes dang / gang zhig rtogs pa'i dus nyid na gang rtogs pa de nyid ni rtags dang rtags can ma yin te zhes so/ /gnyis pa gzhag pa ni/ bem po'i rigs mi mthun gang zhig myong byar skyes pa ste/ rgyan las/ rnam shes bem po'i rang bzhin las/ /bzlog par rab tu skye ba ste/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ myong bya nyid phyir sems yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ gang zag byed las/ ngo bo/ 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi'i/ dang po la/ dbye na 'phags pa dang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i blo gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la rtog pa rtog med gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid gtan la dbab/ de'i dbye ba bstan/ khyad par byed chos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dgag bzhag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phya pas/ don spyi 'dzin pa zhes pa 'dzin pa'i blos ma nges la/ phal cher brjod bya rjod byed 'dre rung 'dzin pa zhes pa ni rtog pas ma nges te/ brjod par bya byed 'dre ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni brjod bya rjod byed 'drer rung bar snang nas sgra don 'dzin pa'i zhen pa ste/ rnam nges las/ rtog pa ni brjod pa dang 'drer rung bar snang ba'i shes pa ste zhes so/ /'o na gzugs med na sgra med pas rtog pa med par 'gyur zhe na skyon med de/ sgra spyi 'dzin pas so/ /gnyis pa la gang zag ngo bo/ yul/ byed pa'i sgo nas dbye ba bzhi'i/ dang po la/ sgra don 'dres par snang ba brda la byang ba'i rtog pa dang / 'dres par mi snang yang 'drer rung bar snang ba byis pa sogs brda la ma byang ba'i rtog pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la/ tshad ma tshad min rnams ma 'khrul ba dang 'khrul pa gnyis te/ dang po ni rjes dpag gnyis pa ni de las gzhan pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ don spyi/ sgra spyi/ de gnyis ka 'dzin pa gsum mam/

rigs sogs/ 'brel pa/ sgra don 'dzin pa gsum du blo gros gnyis kyis bshad pa ltar ram/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par la rtog pa gnyis so/ /bzhi pa la/ nges pa dang the tshom gnyis las dang po la gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i rtog pa ste/ chos mchog tu/ the tshom las bzlog pa ni nges pa yin te zhes dang / nges pa ni gtan la phebs pa ste zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ yang dag pa dang / phyin ci log tu nges pa gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ zhen yul phyin ci ma log par mtha' gcig tu nges pa ste/ dbye na/ rjes dpag dang bcad shes gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ phyin ci log tu mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'o/ /dbye na mi rtag pa la rtag pa dang / snga phyi gcig tu dang / mtshan mo zla zer gyi gos dkar po la ser po dang / mgal me la 'khor lor nges pa lta bu/ ngo bo/ dus/ rnam pa/ yul la phyin ci log tu nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa the tshom la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ kha cig mtha' gzhan du dogs pa zhes pa ni gang zag gis ma nges la/ gtsang nag pas yul la rtse gnyis su 'jug pa zhes pa ni dngos med la the tshom gyi blos ma nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni mtha' gcig ma nges par zhen pa'i rtog pa ste/ shākya blor/ the tshom yang gnyis ka'i cha la brten pa yin pas shes so/ /gnyis pa la dbye na/ mngon du rgyu dang bag la nyal gnyis sam/ cha mnyam pa dang shas cher 'dzin pa'i the tshom gnyis so/ /bag la nyal la rtags la ltos ma ltos gnyis te/ ma nges pa'i rtags la brten pa dang / yid dpyod lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par byed chos bshad pa la brjod bya rjod byed/ brda sbyor tshul/ don rtogs tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis kyi brjod bya la dgag pa ni/ kha cig don rang bzhin sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya yin no zhes pa mi 'thad de/ dngos su brda sbyar ba mi nus pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/

dka' dang mi nus 'bras med phyir/ /dngos po la min zhes so/ /rang bzhin brjod bya gtan ma yin du chu mig pas 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rtog pa'i yul ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rtog yul du rung ba thams cad sgras brjod bya yin la/ dngos kyi brjod bya ni rtog pa'i dngos yul kun yin no/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rjod byed las go bya ste/ rgyan las/ sgra gang zhig ni brjod pa na/ /rtog pa'i don gang yin pa de/ /sgra yi brjod bya yin zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ dngos dang zhes pa'i brjod bya gnyis te/ gzhan sel dang / rang bzhin no/ /de'ang rnam 'grel las/ de dngos sgro btags rtogs pa yis/ /gzhan las ldog pa rtogs phyir yang / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rjod byed la dgag pa ni/ ral gri/ rjod byed mtshan nyid pa sgra spyi'o zhes dang / 'u yug pas/ sgra gang rtog pas brjod bya rjod byed kyi thabs su gyur pa zhes pa ni/ nang gi rjod byed la ma khyab bo/ /gnyis pa gzhag pa la mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya go byed de/ rnam 'grel du/ yi ge don med can 'gyur zhing / /zhes pa'i shugs kyis grub la/ 'dis ni chu mig pa sogs kyis yi ge rjod byed du 'dod pa'ang bkag go /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ nang dang sgra'i rjod byed gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ngo shes pa'i rtog pa ste/ rtog ge'i skad la/ nang gi brjod pa'i rnam pa ni rtog pa ste/ dper na rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i skyes bu 'di ni bum pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rtog pa bzhin no/ /byis pa dang lkugs pa dang dud 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyi nang gi brjod pa'i rnam pa lhur byed pa'i ngo bo'i rtog pa'o zhes dang / gnyis pa la rgyu ni/ chos mchog tu/ sgra'i dngos kyi rgyu ni gnas dang byed pa phrad pa yin la/ de'i rgyu ni brjod par 'dod pa/ de'i rgyu bstan par sems pa yin no zhes pa ltar ro/ /mtshan nyid ni yi ge'i bkod pa la brten nas btags pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra'o/

/dbye ba la/ ngo bo/ brda'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po la ming tshig gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi ngo bo rjod byed kyi sgra ste/ rgyan du gang zhig cha rnams 'dus pa yis/ /don gyi ngo bo ston byed na/ /rnam cha mang ngam nyung gyur kyang / /de ni ming zhes rab tu brjod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa dbye na gnyis las/ dngos ming la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod rgyal thog mar sbyar bas rang gi brjod bya la grags pas mi 'khrul bar grub pa'i ming ste/ rnam 'grel du/ ji ltar grags las grub gang yin/ /dngos dang zhes so/ /dbye na/ lhas byin dang shing zhes pa lta bu ming dang rigs kyi sgra gnyis so/ /gnyis pa btags ming la mtshan nyid ni/ dngos ming la brten nas brda byas pa'i rgyu mtshan can gyi ming ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /gang la de skad brjod phal la/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na 'brel ba dang / sman khra rkang zhes pa lta bu 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu la 'bras bu/ 'bras bu la rgyu/ ya gyal la tshogs pa/ tshogs pa la ya gyal gyi ming gis btags pa'o/ /dper na sgrub ngag la rjes dpag dang / nyi 'od la nyi ma/ ras yug gi phyogs gcig tshig pa la ras yug tshig rnga'i sgra zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshig la/ mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi khyad par ston pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra ste/ rgyan du/ gal te ming gnyis 'dus pa'am/ /'on te mang po 'dus kyang rung / /de dag khyad par rjod byed na/ /tshig ces rab tu brjod pa ste/ /zhes so/ /dbye na bcu ste/ 'bru mang po dang tshig bsdud dang / /khyad par dag dang yan lag dang / /gzhi dang gzhi gcig bsdu ba dang / /gzhi mthun pa dang de'i skyes bu/ /bzlas dbye ba dang phyogs tsam mo/ /zhes pa ltar te dgos pa chung bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa brda'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ dbye ba dngos dang / de'i mu brtsi ba gnyis so/ /dang po la/

chos dang chos can brjod pa gnyis las dang po la mtshan nyid la/ brjod bya'i khyad par gzhan spong ba'i tshul gyis brjod bya go byed kyi sgra ste/ rnam 'grel du/ khyad par gzhan ni spong ba dang / /zhes so/ /dbye na bum pa nyid ces pa lta bu de'i rigs brjod pa dang / bum pa mi rtag pa nyid ces pa lta bu de'i chos brjod yin yang de'i rigs brjod min pa gnyis te/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya'i khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i tshul gyis brjod bya go byed kyi sgra/ rnam 'grel du/ mi spong ba dag ces so/ /khyad par gzhan spong mi spong ni khyad par gzhan blo yul du 'phen mi 'phen no/ /dbye na bum pa zhes pa lta bu/ rang gi tshogs pa can la ltos nas tshogs pa brjod pa dang / tshogs brjod ma yin pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa lta bu gnyis so/ /gnyis pa de'i mu brtsi ba ni/ rigs brjod la tshogs brjod ma yin pa bde ba zhes pa lta bu ste/ bde ba la yig cha med pa'i phyir tshogs brjod yin la/ rigs brjod ma yin pa ni 'bigs byed gangs can ri rab ces pa lta bu ste/ de'i rang bzhin can gyi tshogs pa gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis ka yin pa ni bum pa zhes pa lta bu ste/ tshogs can gser bum sogs la ltos nas rigs brjod dang / rang gi tshogs pa can gzugs dri ro reg bzhi la ltos te tshogs brjod du 'gyur bas so/ /gnyis pa brda sbyor ba'i tshul la/ spyir tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshul ni/ rtog pa la snang ba'i sgra don la phyi rol don du zhen nas de dang de min gnyis su phye nas de min bcad pa'i tshul gyis brda sbyor te/ rnam 'grel du/ gcig rtogs zhes bya'i shes pa ni/ /gcig la gnas pa'i rtogs pa pos/ /de dang de min rgyu don rnams/ /bdag nyid rnam par 'byed par byed/ /blo de la ni yod pa'i dngos/ /blo rgyu nyid du snang ba dang / /rgyu min ngo bo bral ba dang /

/ngo bo gcig 'drar bdag nyid kyis/ /tha dad par ni shes 'gyur bas/ /tha dad pa la skad sbyor te/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dgag sgrub kyi tha snyad sbyor tshul la/ dbye ba dang / bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi sgrub pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul la 'bras bu dang rgyu'i sgo nas brda sbyor tshul gnyis kyi dang po la/ tshogs dang / rgyud dang / gnas skabs khyad par can gyi sgra gsum gyi dang po la/ tshogs pa du ma dang / gcig la 'jug pa gnyis te/ de dag kyang 'bras bu gcig byed pa'i sgo nas brdar byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyun gcig la brten nas sgra gcig brdar byas pa ni min zhes pa lta bu ste/ byis pa dang gzhon nu sogs gnas skabs skabs tha dad pa'i rgyun gcig brjod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni gnas skabs khyad par can du gyur pa'i sgo nas gcig gi tshig sbyar ba ste/ dper na rdul phran so so'i bsdus pa mig shes kyi yul rung du gyur pa na bstan du yod pa zhes sam/ rang gi yul du gzhan 'byung ba'i gegs byed par 'gyur pa la thogs bcas zhes pa'i gcig gi tshig brdar pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i sgo nas brda sbyor ba ni/ ba khra mo dang ser skya'i bu snga phyi dag la ba khra mo'i bu zhes pa'am ser skya'i bu zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dgag pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul la gnyis las/ 'bras bu dgag pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul ni/ 'bras bu bde ba dang gtsang ba sogs bkag pa'i sgo nas zag bcas mi gtsang ba duḥkha ba zhes dang / sgra mig gi gzung bya min zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu bkag pa'i sgo nas sbyor ba ni/ gzhan gyis byed pa po bdag gis bdag gir byas pas bdag rgyu yin pas 'dod pa bkag nas sgra sbyor ba dngos po 'di ni bdag po med pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bsdu ba ni/ de ltar sgra sbyor ba thams cad dgag sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyor bas tha snyad thams cad dgag sgrub kyi tha snyad gnyis las mi 'da' ste/

rnam 'grel du/ dgag dang sgrub pa ma gtogs par/ /sgra las byung ba'i tha snyad gzhan/ /yod min zhes so/ /gsum pa don rtogs tshul ni/ rjod byed kyi sgra las brda dang tha snyad kyi dus kyi don gcig tu 'khrul nas brda ci lta ba bzhin du tha snyad kyi dus su yang don go ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de las de rtogs gyur pa'i blo/ /'khrul ba'i dngos po gcig ltar rtogs/ /zhes so/ /de dang rjod byed kyi sgra thams cad kyi rjes 'gro dngos dang / ldog pa shugs kyis brjod pas rtogs pas kyang de ltar dngos shugs la go ste/ shākya blor/ sgra'i rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa brjod par bya ba yin te/ rjes su 'gro ba ni dngos su brjod pa dang / ldog pa ni shugs kyis brjod pa lta bar bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa rtog med la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid la dang po dgag pa ni/ kha cig don spyi mi 'dzin pa la 'dod pa ni dngos med kyis ma nges so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ rang yul gsal bar snang ba'i blo ste/ chos mchog tu/ gsal bar snang ba yin pa'i phyir rnam par rtog pa med par grub pa yin la zhes so/ /dbye na/ 'khrul ma 'khrul la gnyis te mtshan nyid dang dbye bas so/ /dang po la dgag pa ni/ bsod rgyal/ blo gang snang yul la ltos te 'dres rung 'dzin pa dang mi bslu bas stong pa zhes pa ni dbang shes dang yid shes rtog med 'khrul pa la ma khyab bo/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ phyin ci log tu gsal bar snang ba'i rig pa'o/ /dbye na dbang shes dang yid shes 'khrul pa gnyis te/ rnam nges su/ nye bar bslad pas bslu ba'i phyir/ /mngon sum ltar snang zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ 'dis ni yid kyis rnam par bslad pa yang bshad pa yin no zhes so/ /dang po la dbye na/ zla ba gnyis 'dzin dang / mgal me la 'khor lo dang / dung ser 'dzin/ grur zhugs pa las shing sogs 'gro bar snang ba lta bu yul/ don byed pa'i rang bzhin/

rnam pa/ bya ba la 'khrul pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rmi lam gsal snang dang / zad par zil gnon la sogs pa bsgoms byung min pa dang / bsgoms byung gi gsal snang gnyis yod do/ /rtog med ma 'khrul ba ni mngon sum ste 'og tu 'chad do/ /gsum pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis las mtshan nyid ni/ phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo ste/ rnam 'grel gyi rang 'grel du/ 'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid ni phyin ci log tu snang ba yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na rtog pa dang / rtog med 'khrul pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad ma yin pas 'og nas 'chad do/ /gsum pa 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ snang ba dang sel bas 'jug pas blo gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis las mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas myong stobs kyi yul du byed pa zhes pa ni kun mkhyen gyi blo gzhan gyi bde sdug la sgrub 'jug ma yin par thal zhing / 'u yug pa blo gang yul de'i rnam pa snang nas 'dzin pa zhes pa ni blos ma nges so/ /gnyis pa gzhag pa ni char phye bar gsal bar snang ba'i blo ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don gyi rang gi ngo bo gcig /bdag nyid mngon sum yin pa la/ /tshad ma rnams kyis brtag bya gang / /ma mthong cha gzhan ci zhig yod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis las/ snang ba 'khrul ba la mtshan nyid ni/ char ma phye bar phyin ci log tu gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa'o/ /dbye na rtog med 'khrul pa ltar gnyis te/ gnyis pa snang ba ma 'khrul ba la mtshan nyid ni char ma phye ba'i sgo nas phyin ci ma log par gsal bar snang bar snang ba'i shes pa'o/ /dbye na don rig mngon sum dang rang rig go /gnyis pa rtogs bya yul la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba/ mu brtsi ba gsum gyi dang po la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ chos gang zhig rnam pa blo la shar ba la brten nas nges par bya ba zhes pa ni rtog med kyis ma nges te/

rtog pa min pas nges byed min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ blos rig par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la snang yul/ zhen yul/ 'jug yul/ gzung yul bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ snang bas rig bya'o/ /dbye na rtog med ma 'khrul ba dang rtog pa'i snang yul gnyis so/ /dang po la bem rig gnyis dang / gnyis pa la dgag sgrub gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ zhen nas rtogs par bya ba ste shes bya thams cad do/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la rtogs tshul dang / don byed mi byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis las/ dang po gnyis kyi rang bzhin nyid ni don dam par don byed pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don dam don byed nus pa gang / /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye na bem rig gnyis so/ /gnyis pa spyi mtshan la mtshan nyid ni/ don dam du don mi byed pa'i chos te/ de nyid du/ gzhan ni kun rdzob yin pa ste/ /zhes so/ /dbye na spyi bye brag gnyis las/ spyi la rigs spyi/ tshogs spyi/ don spyi/ bsdu ba'i spyi/ rnam brtag gi spyi ste lnga'i dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas/ rang gi bye brag la ltos pa'i rigs mi mthun las log pa zhes pa ni spyis ma nges te/ rang gi bye brag mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ rang gis khyab bya'i gsal ba la thun mong bar khyab pa'i rigs ldog ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don gyi ngo bo nyid kyi spyi/ /kun la ngo bo mtshungs phyir dang / /de ldog pa la brten phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /dbye na dngos po dang dngos med gnyis ka la brten pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa tshogs spyi la mtshan nyid ni/ chos du ma 'dus pa'i chos can gang zhig rang gi tshogs pa can la khyab byed thun mong bar grub pa ste/ rgyal dbang blor/ tshogs pa ni bsdus pa tsam yin zhing blos kun btags pa kho na ste zhes so/ /dbye na tshogs pa gcig dang du ma'o/

/gsum pa don spyi ni/ gsal ba du ma la gcig tu zhen pa'i rtog pa'i rnam pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ dngos rnams ngo bo 'ga' zhig gis/ /tha dad min pa lta bur snang / /de la bsam pa'i dbang gis na/ /phyi yod par ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa bsdu ba'i spyi ni/ gzhi mthun pa'i spyi de/ dper na bum pa yang yin la dngos po yang yin zhes pa lta bu ste/ dbye na/ dngos po dang dngos med gnyis ka la brten pa gsum mo/ /lnga pa rnam brtag gi spyi ni/ phyogs gnyis gang rung gi spyi ste/ dper na gong bu 'ga' zhig ba lang ba men gang rung du the tshom za zhing / ba lang ba men gang rung yin pa na ba lang ba men gang rung gi spyi lta bu the tshom rnam brtag gi spyi ste/ gang rung du nges na de'i spyi mi srid de/ rnam par brtag pa dang gcig tu so sor nges pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes rnam nges las so/ /gnyis pa bye brag la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ khyad par ldog pa gnyis tshogs pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ 'di ltar ldog pa'i ngo bo can/ /des na tha dad med lta bu/ /de nyid gzhan las ldog par yang / /snang ste/ zhes so/ /dbye na/ rigs/ tshogs/ bsdu ba/ rnam brtag gi bye brag bzhi'am/ dngos po/ dngos med/ gnyis ka la brten pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa don byed mi byed kyi sgo nas dbye na dngos po dang dngos med gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ don byed pa ste/ rigs thigs su/ dngos dang dngos po'i mtshan nyid don byed nus pa kho na yin pa'i phyir zhes so/ /dbye ba la ngo bo dang byed pa'i sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis las/ dang po la/ dngos po gcig dang tha dad gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ don byed nus pa dag gcig pa ste/ dbye na bum pa lta bu tha mi dad pa dang / tha dad la byas mi rtag lta bu khyab mnyam pa dang / bum pa dang mi rtag pa lta bu khyab mi mnyam pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/

don byed pa gang / ngo bo tha dad pa'o/ /dbye na tsha grang lta bu 'gal la/ me du lta bu 'gal zhing 'brel pa/ ka bum lta bu 'gal 'brel gnyis ka min pa ste gsum mo/ /byed pa'i sgo nas dbye na bem rig gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ thogs bcas gang zhig rigs mi mthun no/ /dbye na/ phyi'i yul lnga/ nang gi dbang po lnga'o/ /rig pa bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa dngos med la mtshan nyid ni/ don byed pas stong ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de mi rung phyir rang bzhin med/ /de ni dngos med mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye na chos chos can gnyis so/ /gsum pa 'jug yul la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ kha cig tshad mas rtogs bya zhes pa ni/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyi gzung don bum pa'i skad cig chos can/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyi 'jug yul du thal/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyis rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos mchog tu/ thob par bya ba yang 'dir 'jug pa'i yul nyid la nges par brtag par bya ba yin la zhes dang / mngon sum gyis bzung ba'i don ni thob par rung ba ma yin te/ skad cig ma nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ tshad mas gzhal ba ltar yongs su bcad nas thob par byar rung ste/ chos mchog tu/ yongs su bcad pa'i don nyid 'jug pa'i yul yin gyi zhes so/ /dbye na mngon gyur lkog gyur gnyis sam/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'jug yul gnyis/ bzhi pa gzung yul la dgag gzhag gnyis so/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba dgag pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snga rabs pa dag 'dzin pa la snang rung zhes pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtog med 'khrul pa chos can/ skra shad zla gnyis kyang gzung yul du thal/ skra shad zla gnyis 'dzin pa la snang rung ba'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/ 'khrul pa'i shes pa can rnams kyis/ /zla gnyis med bzhin tha dad mthong / /zhes so/ /'dod par mi nus te/ chos mchog tu/ rab rib la sogs pa dbang po nyams pa las skyes pa ni phyin ci log gi rnam pa bzhag pa'i phyir/
